title: Business Mgt & Operations -  Intern
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
Location:Amsterdam (ING Acanthus)
The Center of Expertise (CoE) Brand, Marketing & Communications is looking for a intern of the Business Management & Operations team covering all the departmental financials incl reporting and purchase ordering, procurement, non-financial risk, HR and (change) projects.
At the CoE Brand, Marketing and Communications, we accelerate business growth through creativity. It is our vision to become the most impactful, collaborative, creative and forward thinking CoE. Known for its contribution to sustainable business growth and respected for its strategic and creative value add. We are a strategic partner to the business delivering engaging & creative Brand, Marketing and Communications.
As a bank and one of the most familiar brands in the Netherlands, working for the CoE requires the ability to work in a highly dynamic and complex landscape, servicing the wide base of ING customers as well as all product tribes and business lines within ING NL.
As an intern lead you’ll report into the Head of the Business Management and Operations and you’ll be collaborating with a team of five professionals.
At the heart of our CoE Brand, Marketing & Communications department, the Business Management & Operations team is dedicated to empowering our department with seamless and robust processes, sound financial stewardship and strategic risk mitigation.
We strive to create a foundation of excellence enabling our Brand, Marketing & Communications visionaries to innovate fearlessly, drive impactful campaigns, and achieve unparalleled success.
Our commitment is to foster a dynamic and resilient environment where every challenge is met with confidence, and every opportunity is maximised for the growth and prosperity of our organisation.
Roles and responsibilities
Business Management: being the right hand of the Head of Business Management & Operations and support preparation of meetings.
Budget management: Helping the experts to monitor and control the marketing budget for ING NL,
and ordering / invoicing on marketing expenses.
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
To take on this challenging and rewarding opportunity, you’ll need:
Studying in Business Administration or similar.
Creative way of thinking and innovative mindset combined with a being team player, fun and engaging attitude.
Passion for the banking business and Marketing, Brand & Communications in particular.
Fluent in English and Dutch speaking and in (copy) writing. Strong communication skills.
This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.
You’ll also benefit from:
Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on 36 hours work week
Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders).
Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.
About our internships
Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship).
Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
